value_prop.text: No evidence in the bundle; hypothesis to test: By combining embedded normalizing flows with empirical-likelihood estimation under moment restrictions, users can perform simulation-based parameter estimation while bypassing complex unknown distributions of residual information.

riskiest_assumption.text: The riskiest assumption is designated due to missing evidence on axis V (viability). We assume that target users are willing to pay for a software framework combining embedded normalizing flows and empirical-likelihood estimation for parameter estimation.
